#!/bin/bash
# Poll remote server for experiment completion
while true; do
    # Check unconstrained progress
    unc_count=$(ssh westd-21461 "wc -l < /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/d062_beam4_unconstrained.jsonl 2>/dev/null" 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
    
    # Check if constrained file exists and its progress
    con_count=$(ssh westd-21461 "wc -l < /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/d062_beam4_constrained.jsonl 2>/dev/null" 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
    
    # Check if process is still running
    running=$(ssh westd-21461 "ps aux | grep run_d062_beam_latency | grep -v grep | wc -l" 2>/dev/null || echo "1")
    
    if [ "$con_count" -ge 551 ] 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "DONE: Both runs complete. Unconstrained=$unc_count, Constrained=$con_count"
        break
    fi
    
    if [ "$running" = "0" ] && [ "$unc_count" -ge 1 ] 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "PROCESS_ENDED: Script finished or crashed. Unconstrained=$unc_count, Constrained=$con_count"
        break
    fi
    
    # Emit progress every 5 minutes
    now=$(date +%s)
    if [ -z "$last_report" ] || [ $((now - last_report)) -ge 300 ]; then
        echo "PROGRESS: Unconstrained=$unc_count/551, Constrained=$con_count/551"
        last_report=$now
    fi
    
    sleep 60
done
EOF
